description: Agent-native X (Twitter) posting as one MCP server; every post clears a server-side guardrail.
name: io.github.vb-tyagi/capx-cafe

environmentVariables.description: URL of the hosted capx chokepoint that enforces the server-side guardrail on every post
environmentVariables.name: CAPX_CHOKEPOINT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Whitelisted user email used to authenticate to the chokepoint
environmentVariables.name: CAPX_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Connection lane: 'byo' (bring your own X app) or 'capx-app' (capx-managed app)
environmentVariables.name: CAPX_LANE

environmentVariables.description: X (Twitter) OAuth client ID; required only on the BYO lane
environmentVariables.name: X_CLIENT_ID

title: capx café
